scope: all git-tracked *.md (722 files, 87,251 lines). The artifact's 710 / 90,600 figures were group-level estimates; 90,600 was never lines reconciled.

rule.precedence: stale > drift > debt > current (pre-registered before counting)
rule.stale: in _ARCHIVE/ or archive/; OR self-declares superseded/deprecated/archived at line start; OR 0 inbound basename refs AND untouched >30d AND >=50% of backticked path refs missing
rule.drift: >=1 backticked repo path ref not in tree (gitignored paths excluded via git check-ignore)
rule.debt: >=3 open markers (unchecked boxes, TODO, TBD, FIXME, not built)

dormant_signal.note: non-stale files with 0 inbound refs and untouched >45d; a review list, not a class

operators.op19_accountant: bound READY, not run: input contract is receipts+outcomes, not doc usage; feeding docs would fabricate
operators.op20_folksonomy: bound READY, not run: input is receipts mapped to 54-dim seeds, gated at 100 receipts; docs are out of contract
operators.op21_librarian: bound READY (arcs_store.recommend), not run: ranks a receipts store, not files
operators.substitute: deterministic 5-word-shingle Jaccard (>=0.5) or containment (>=0.8), union-find clusters, keeper = most inbound refs then most recent

unique.line: - CI cancel-in-progress on main means rapid merges leave only the newest commit's run as the verdict.
unique.why_material: Durable CI-reading rule: with concurrency cancel-in-progress on main (.github/workflows/ci.yml, security.yml, intent.yml), intermediate merge commits never get a completed run, so 'post-merge CI green' must be read off the newest commit only and earlier merges are unverified. Recurs in every multi-merge session (v3.110 open item 4).
